items.title: Carrier
items.placementTarget: Character card, across two scar slots
items.text:
Carrier: You have the sample in your body.
• Your pawn may be moved only by doing the Drive/Ferry action.
• To enter a city, you must discard a card matching its color.
• At game end, win or lose, destroy this character.

mechanics.trigger: Used when doing the Self-Infect action only
mechanics.effect: The character has the sample in their body. At game end, win or lose, destroy this character.
restrictions: Your pawn may be moved only by doing the Drive/Ferry action.
To enter a city, you must discard a card matching its color.

items.title: SCARS
items.text:
SCARS
Use these scars when doing the Self-Infect action only.

mechanics.effect: These scars are used when doing the Self-Infect action only.

summary: Two more double-slot Carrier scar stickers and the same Self-Infect-only scars label as door 27. Wording matches door 27 exactly, including the white movement bullet. Count in this door is 2. The sticker image is byte-identical to door 27, and Workshop guids fb15cd and 2262a6 are the same pair.
